dataset: King County RoadClosures_public bounded closure timestamp map
license: King County public road-closure service terms; bounded sample for reproducibility tests
preparation_steps: Saved one bounded non-test closure feature from King County RoadClosures_public Closures layer.
Converted ArcGIS epoch-millisecond starttime/endtime to ISO-8601 UTC timestamps.
Used the first closure segment midpoint as the representative event point.
boundary_note: Bounded real official road-closure timestamp map only; not traffic-flow validity, not production map matching, not route-choice validation, not incident calibration, and not a full live feed.
